pages.text: A hollow square ring of $(item)Accelerator Segments$(), one block high, between 5x5 and 15x15, with one $(item)Particle Accelerator Controller$() in the ring.$(br2)Bigger rings are faster but use more power.

pages.name: Particle Accelerator (7x7)
pages.text: A 7x7 ring: an Input port on the east side, an Output port on the west.

$(item)Accelerator Ports$() are Input or Output as a whole block; switch one with the Wrench in Configure mode. Input ports take power and hydrogen; Output ports push antimatter out.$(br2)Antimatter only goes into $(item)Containment Cells$() and $(item)Magnetic Conduits$().
